title: 길 좀 물을게요
scene: 종로. 길을 물었더니 어르신 셋이 서로 다른 길을 알려 준다
goal: Asking directions — and getting three answers

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Excuse me, how do I get to Gwangjang Market?
turns.note: 어떻게 가요? = how do I get to

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Go straight that way. Ten minutes.

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: No, take the subway. One stop.

turns.speaker: D
turns.en: What are you talking about, the bus is faster.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: The bus gets stuck in traffic! Walk!

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 저… 잘 모르겠어요. 다시 한 번 말해 주세요.
turns.rd: jeo… jal moreugesseoyo. dasi han beon malhae juseyo.
turns.en: Um… I'm not sure. Please say it again.

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: Oh come on, we'll just take you there.
